電線桿上的變壓器傳出很大的聲響。
The new CEO was a transformer who changed the whole company.
新任執行長是個改革者，改變了整家公司。
Technology is a transformer of the way we learn.
科技改變了我們學習的方式。
He is perpetually late for meetings.
他開會總是遲到。
The mountain top is perpetually covered in snow.
山頂終年積雪。
A rhino can weigh more than a car.
犀牛的重量可能超過一輛車。
We saw a rhino drinking at the pond.
我們看到一隻犀牛在池塘邊喝水。
The VIP was escorted to a private room.
貴賓被護送到私人包廂。
Only VIPs may enter this area.
只有貴賓能進入這個區域。
The two companies reached a consensual agreement.
兩家公司達成了雙方同意的協議。
Any medical test must be consensual.
任何醫療檢查都必須經過本人同意。

政府正努力防止年輕人走向極端主義。
Extremism in any form is a threat to peace.
任何形式的極端主義都是對和平的威脅。

penelope.zh: 佩涅洛佩（希臘神話中奧德修斯的妻子）
ai: In Greek myth, Penelope waited many years for Odysseus.
在希臘神話中，佩涅洛佩等了奧德修斯許多年。
Penelope is a character in Homer's Odyssey.
佩涅洛佩是荷馬《奧德賽》中的角色。

訂單若有任何問題，請打服務專線。
The bank has a 24-hour helpline.
這家銀行有二十四小時的服務專線。
The singer received a standing ovation.
歌手獲得了全場起立鼓掌。
The crowd gave the team a warm ovation.
群眾向球隊報以熱烈的掌聲。
The soldiers wore khaki in the desert.
士兵們在沙漠中穿著卡其色制服。
He bought a pair of khakis for work.
他買了一件卡其褲上班穿。
She wore a khaki jacket over a white shirt.
她在白襯衫外面穿了一件卡其色外套。

帳篷是卡其色的，和草地融為一體。

選舉後，這個國家的首相職位換人了。

在她擔任首相期間，經濟穩定成長。

skye.zh: 斯凱島（蘇格蘭西部的島嶼）
ai: The Isle of Skye is known for its rugged mountains.
斯凱島以崎嶇的山脈聞名。

我們去蘇格蘭旅行時，走橋前往斯凱島。

我喜歡牙買加音樂，尤其是雷鬼。
She cooked a Jamaican dish for dinner.
她晚餐煮了一道牙買加料理。
The Jamaican won the sprint by a wide margin.
那位牙買加人以明顯的差距贏得短跑。
My neighbor is a Jamaican who loves cricket.
我的鄰居是個愛打板球的牙買加人。
The finder of the lost wallet received a reward.
找到那個遺失皮夾的人得到了獎賞。
The finder of the old coin took it to a museum.
發現那枚古錢幣的人把它送到博物館。
Look through the finder to frame your photo.
透過觀景窗來取景拍照。
The telescope has a small finder on top.
望遠鏡上方有一個小的尋星鏡。

檸檬汁的酸度讓它嚐起來很酸。
Too much acidity in the soil can harm the plants.
土壤酸性過高會傷害植物。

今年的慶典吸引了數千名遊客。
Bright flowers are attracting bees to the garden.
鮮豔的花朵正把蜜蜂吸引到花園來。
The weakest player on the team was still very good.
隊上最弱的球員還是很強。
Math is my weakest subject.
數學是我最弱的科目。
She was the standout of the whole class.
她是全班最傑出的人。
The soup was the standout of the meal.
這道湯是整頓飯中最出色的一道。
He gave a standout performance in the final.
他在決賽中有出色的表現。
The standout feature of the phone is its battery life.
這支手機最突出的特色是電池續航力。

政府宣布鐵路國有化。
Nationalisation of the industry was a hot debate.
這個產業的國有化是熱門的辯論議題。
The mystic spent years in silent prayer in the mountains.
那位神祕主義者在山中默默祈禱了多年。
Many mystics believe in a deep connection with the universe.
許多神祕主義者相信人與宇宙有深刻的連結。
The old temple has a mystic atmosphere.
這座老廟有一種神祕的氛圍。
She wrote about mystic rituals in ancient times.
她寫了古代神祕的儀式。
He pulled out his checkbook to pay the bill.
他拿出支票簿來付帳。
My grandmother still balances her checkbook every month.
我奶奶每個月仍會核對她的支票簿。

她是個精明的女商人，很少犯錯。

他敏銳的意見幫助我們解決了問題。

有兩票反對、一票棄權。

他的棄權讓在場的人都很驚訝。

治療期間建議戒酒。
Total abstention from sweets was hard for the kids.
完全不吃甜食對孩子們來說很難。
Galileo used a telescope to observe the moons of Jupiter.
伽利略用望遠鏡觀察木星的衛星。
Galileo was an Italian scientist who lived in the 1500s and 1600s.
伽利略是生活在十六至十七世紀的義大利科學家。
A tiger prowled through the tall grass.
一隻老虎在高高的草叢中潛行。
Cats prowl the streets at night looking for food.
貓在夜裡漫步街頭找食物。
The cat was on the prowl in the garden.
貓在花園裡四處潛行。
Wolves are on the prowl at night.
狼在夜裡到處搜尋獵物。

舊城牆只剩下少數遺跡。
The ruins are a vestige of an ancient civilization.
這些廢墟是古文明的遺跡。
There was not a vestige of doubt in her mind.
她心中沒有一絲懷疑。
He kept a vestige of hope until the end.
他到最後仍保有一絲希望。
The singer can reach a full octave higher than most people.
這位歌手能唱到比一般人高整整一個八度。

把同一個音降低一個八度彈奏。
She keeps a small glass figurine on her desk.
她在書桌上擺了一個小小的玻璃塑像。
I bought a wooden figurine as a souvenir.
我買了一座木雕小像當紀念品。

malawi.zh: 馬拉威（非洲東南部國家）
ai: Malawi is a country in southeastern Africa.
馬拉威是非洲東南部的國家。
Lake Malawi is one of the largest lakes in Africa.
馬拉威湖是非洲最大的湖泊之一。
Fertilization happens when a sperm cell meets an egg.
受精發生在精子與卵子結合時。
The book explains how fertilization works in plants.
這本書解釋了植物如何受精。
Regular fertilization helps the garden grow well.
定期施肥有助於花園生長良好。
The farmer was careful about the fertilization of his fields.
農夫對田地的施肥非常謹慎。
Nairobi is the capital of Kenya.
奈洛比是肯亞的首都。
Many safari trips start from Nairobi.
許多野生動物旅遊行程都從奈洛比出發。
We had roasted quail for dinner.
我們晚餐吃了烤鵪鶉。
A quail ran across the path with its chicks.
一隻鵪鶉帶著小雞跑過小徑。
The child quailed at the sight of the big dog.
孩子一看到那隻大狗就嚇得發抖。
He did not quail when facing the angry crowd.
面對憤怒的群眾，他毫不畏縮。

belgrade.zh: 貝爾格勒（塞爾維亞首都）
ai: Belgrade is the capital of Serbia.
貝爾格勒是塞爾維亞的首都。
Belgrade lies where the Sava and Danube rivers meet.
貝爾格勒位於薩瓦河與多瑙河的交會處。
Long years of habit entrenched the old way of working.
多年的習慣讓舊的工作方式根深蒂固。
The company tried to entrench its position in the market.
公司試圖鞏固它在市場上的地位。
The group is nonpartisan and supports no political party.
這個團體是無黨派的，不支持任何政黨。
The judge asked for a nonpartisan review of the case.
法官要求對此案進行超黨派的審查。
The fuselage of the plane was painted white.
飛機的機身漆成白色。
Workers checked the fuselage for cracks.
工人檢查機身有沒有裂縫。
We watched the fireworks from afar.
我們從遠處觀賞煙火。
Visitors came from afar to see the festival.
遊客從遠方來看這場慶典。

assisted.zh: 幫助；協助（assist 的過去式）
ai: A nurse assisted the doctor during the surgery.
護理師在手術中協助醫生。
Volunteers assisted the elderly across the street.
志工協助老人過馬路。
The hospital offers assisted living for older people.
這間醫院為年長者提供協助式照護的居住服務。
It was an assisted rescue, so everyone was safe.
那是一場有人協助的救援，所以大家都平安。
Arterial blood carries oxygen from the heart.
動脈血把氧氣從心臟輸送出去。
The doctor checked for arterial blockage.
醫生檢查是否有動脈阻塞。
The arterial road is crowded during rush hour.
幹線道路在尖峰時段很擁擠。
They are widening the arterial route into the city.
他們正在拓寬進城的主要幹道。
The restaurant plans to revamp its menu this fall.
這間餐廳計畫在今年秋天改版菜單。
They revamped the website to make it easier to use.
他們把網站改版得更好用。
Subsidence damaged several houses near the old mine.
地層下陷損壞了舊礦場附近的幾棟房屋。
The city is studying the subsidence of the ground.
這座城市正在研究地面的下陷。
Sand is partly made of quartz.
沙子有一部分是由石英組成的。
The watch has a quartz movement.
這支手錶用的是石英機芯。

他眼神中帶著狂亂的神情。
The week before the exam was manic for everyone.
考試前一週大家都忙得發狂。
The dictionary shows the phonetic spelling of each word.
字典標示了每個字的音標。
She studied phonetic differences between accents.
她研究不同口音在語音上的差異。
The children shouted with glee when it snowed.
下雪時，孩子們開心地大叫。

聽到好消息，他高興得搓著手。

她放學後參加很多課外活動。
Extracurricular clubs help students make friends.
課外社團能幫助學生交朋友。
The shop sells Afghan rugs.
這間店賣阿富汗地毯。
She learned about Afghan history at school.
她在學校學到了阿富汗的歷史。
The Afghan welcomed us warmly into his home.
那位阿富汗人熱情地請我們到他家。
She keeps a knitted afghan on the sofa.
她在沙發上放著一條針織毛毯。
Saying the exam was hard is an understatement.
說這次考試很難還算是輕描淡寫了。
It would be an understatement to call the trip tiring.
說這趟旅程累人，都還算說得保守了。
We went to an orchestral concert last night.
我們昨晚去聽了一場管弦樂音樂會。
The film has a beautiful orchestral score.
這部電影有優美的管弦樂配樂。
